role: Real on-page SEO scan against real HTML — title presence/length range, meta description presence, H1 presence exactly once. Same regex-scanning discipline as E-07/E-21.
behaviorDescription: scanPage() checks real HTML for title tag presence and length range (10-60 chars), meta description presence, and H1 presence (flagging both zero and multiple H1s). Verified against a good-SEO case (zero findings) and a real bad-SEO case before implementation.
hardStops: Never modifies any page content — strictly read-only scanning
Never fabricates a finding not grounded in a real regex match against the actual HTML
